caption: illusion's notorious 3d fighter - the sequel that doubled down on the infamy and the weapons.
about: Battle raper 2 (2005) is illusion's 3d fighting game with the series' full adult payload: weapon-based combat with armor-breaking mechanics, a story mode through the sealed lands, and the explicit defeat system that made the franchise infamous. The fighting engine underneath is more functional than its reputation suggests - and the reputation is exactly why it is documented here.
The windows build was japan-only and is long off sale; the archive route is the only door.
